item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: HappyMe Properties respects your privacy. We collect only the information necessary to respond to enquiries and manage our services. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Information provided through our contact form is used solely for sales and support, and is retained according to applicable data protection standards.

item.title: Terms and Conditions
item.description: These terms govern your use of the HappyMe Properties website and any services provided through it. By submitting an enquiry, you agree to our use of your contact details for follow-up communications. All information displayed on this site is provided for illustrative purposes and may be subject to change. Final pricing, specifications and availability are confirmed through the sales team.
